goal: All biblically named or explicitly described geographic entities in the 73-book Catholic canon, with links to mentions, people, events, historical chronology and defensible modern locations.

current_app.source_reader_production: Existing Scripture passage/full chapter/commentary must be reused; do not introduce a separate bible content pipeline
current_app.inflight_note: 932 restores 73-book Douay source witness; Atlas work cannot mutate Scripture reader, source witnesses or translation/certification flags.

candidate_datasets.title: OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data
candidate_datasets.license_claim: CC BY 4.0 DATA, ODbL on OpenStreetMap-derived geography
candidate_datasets.content_scope: Every identifiable toponym in the Protestant 66-book corpus; verse mentions, alternate identifications and uncertain/unknown places
candidate_datasets.count_definition: Ancient AND modern indexed place objects together per website search, NOT number of distinct biblical places
candidate_datasets.selection_note: Preserve ancient place ID, distinct modern location ID, confidence/votes and unknown/special resolution. Do not auto-promote resolved lat/lon.

candidate_datasets.title: STEPBible Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References
candidate_datasets.file: TIPNR - Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References - STEPBible.org CC BY.txt
candidate_datasets.license_claim: Current repo README says CC BY 4.0; check license notice inside exact TIPNR file and exact commit before commercial distribution
candidate_datasets.content_scope: Biblical persons, places, names, original-language forms, known verse citations, relational data
candidate_datasets.auto_content_caution: Some later descriptive articles are AI-generated per upstream documentation; do not copy as authoritative site history; extract structured proper-name and verse relations only
candidate_datasets.canon_gap: Do not assume complete Catholic deuterocanonical coverage from an ESV-centric base.

candidate_datasets.title: Existing Ad Orientem Scripture source/versification owners
candidate_datasets.content_scope: 73 book names/IDs; edition-specific Psalms/Esther/Song of Songs and other alignments; in-app passage reader
candidate_datasets.restriction: No duplicate verse texts or automatic verse-alignment based on word spelling.

candidate_datasets.title: Franciscan Custody of the Holy Land sanctuary directory
candidate_datasets.content_scope: 27 site names from separate explored source index; original site histories and Franciscan pilgrim monuments
candidate_datasets.restriction: Modern Custody site location may be traditional attribution not literal named Gospel toponym; ecclesiastical site not interchangeable with ancient place.

candidate_datasets.title: Catholic seven-deuterocanonical-book and Greek-additions gap audit
candidate_datasets.content_scope: Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch, 1 Maccabees, 2 Maccabees; plus Esther, Daniel and relevant Greek text versification
candidate_datasets.requirement: Extract named and described places from all Catholic-only verses; mark books without explicit named places rather than inventing them.

strict_completion_gate: Enumerate exact unique ancient place/place-sense IDs from imported upstream ancient.jsonl, separate from modern geographic object count.
Crosswalk every ancient ID to Catholic 73-book occurrence register and add Catholic-only location mentions; classify unresolved, symbolic, narrative described but unnamed locations.
Expose each place's every verse reference with edition-normalized coordinates or an explicit fail-closed warning; ensure 73-book full scan not just books with explicit geography.

Join biblical places to real geography Places only with site identity evidence; one modern town can represent several ancient settlements and one biblical site can have multiple competing modern identifications.
Acquire source-backed events, figures, plausible period date ranges, and at least one source for every factual paragraph in user-facing educational context.
Keep no-coordinate, uncertain and multi-location entries searchable without plotting fabricated pins or roads; preserve proportional region geometry rather than converting it to exact points.
Reuse native Scripture Passage / Full chapter / Commentary drawer, on-device text witness, exact back/scroll handoff, language selection, and existing Crampon/DR/CPDV edition checks.
No UI or publication before quality, attribution, source-rights and regression/phone acceptance gates.
